mapper.sql: id, project_id, topic_name, question_count, representative_questions, involved_modules, analysis, status, reject_reason, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hotspot_topic (project_id, topic_name, question_count, representative_questions, involved_modules, analysis, status, reject_reason, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{topicName}, #{questionCount}, #{representativeQuestions}, #{involvedModules}, #{analysis}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE hotspot_topic SET topic_name = #{topicName}, question_count = #{questionCount}, representative_questions = #{representativeQuestions}, involved_modules = #{involvedModules}, analysis = #{analysis}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hotspot_topic WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY question_count DESC
